a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan has only about a 1% chance of saving either of us, since it needs 2 operate rounds plus a take round. The reserve holds 4, enough to save one of us now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1, so I'm openly breaking the agreement rather than doing it behind your back. If you take too, the random split decides it fairly. If anything is left afterward, I'll operate with you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
